summary: Full E2E testing of Quick Order (QO) app - backend APIs (13 pytest cases) + frontend flows (login/register+CAPTCHA, cart→checkout→invoice, WA link, done-send-proof, admin approve, purchase-completed+print, history, dark toggle, admin product CRUD, admin settings save). Everything works end-to-end.
backend_test_results: 13/13 passed (auth, products, settings, cart, order lifecycle including approve+reject, admin CRUD, non-admin 403 gating).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: Uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). Migrate to lifespan context manager (harmless but deprecated).
server.py update_settings accepts arbitrary dict body without Pydantic schema; consider validating allowed keys and coercing types to prevent bad data being persisted.
StatusBadge shows abbreviated label ('Waiting Confirmation') while banner says 'Waiting Admin Confirmation'. Not a bug but the shorter badge may be confusing to users; consider aligning.
server.py `list_products` `all` query param shadows Python builtin `all` (works but bad practice).
Password reset endpoint does not invalidate existing tokens/sessions - JWT continues to work until expiry. Consider adding token version / revocation.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook expected 5-fail lockout was not present in this build). Documented as info only since spec did not require it.
